attacks.name: Inferno Rider - Echo Skill 1
attacks.sourceText:
Transform into the Inferno Rider to launch up to 3 consecutive slashes in a row, each slash dealing 151.50%, 176.75%, and 176.75% Fusion DMG respectively.
After the final hit, increase the current Resonator's Fusion DMG by 12.00% and Basic Attack DMG by 12.00% for 15s.
Long press the Echo Skill to transform into the Inferno Rider and enter Riding Mode. When exiting Riding Mode, deal 176.75% Fusion DMG to enemies in front.
